lemma irrational_sqrt_six : Irrational (Real.sqrt 6) := by
  rw [irrational_sqrt_ofNat_iff]
  exact not_isSquare_six

lemma sqrt_two_mul_sqrt_three : Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt 3 = Real.sqrt 6 := by
  rw [← Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num)]
  norm_num

lemma sq_sqrt_two_add_sqrt_three : (Real.sqrt 2 + Real.sqrt 3) ^ 2 = 5 + 2 * Real.sqrt 6 := by
  rw [add_sq]
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)]
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)]
  have h : 2 * Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt 3 = 2 * Real.sqrt 6 := by
    rw [mul_assoc, sqrt_two_mul_sqrt_three]
  rw [h]
  ring

premises.name: Real.sqrt

The square root of a real number. This returns 0 for negative inputs.
